title: UI view definitions
description: Building blocks shared by the UI view schemas (app/ui-*.schema.json). Nothing here is a message by itself. The views carry codes and data, never prose: the desktop UI writes the words. Absence is an explicit null or 'nodata', never a default.

day_level.title: DayLevel
day_level.description: Traffic-light level of a day or of today, or 'nodata' when there is no assessment. Never a green by default.

task_code.title: TaskCode
task_code.description: Something the astronaut still has to do. TASK_DAILY_REPORT: daily self-report. TASK_ODI: weekly Oswestry report. TASK_BASELINE_SESSION: a pre-flight reference session. TASK_SESSION: the planned exercise session.

session_state.title: SessionState
session_state.description: Lifecycle of a session in the app: starting (start command sent), running (acked by the gateway), rejected (refused, timed out or bus down), ended, processing (features and assessment being computed), processed, processing_failed.

band.title: Band
band.description: Elastic band of a protocol, as in catalog/protocol-catalog.json.

fit_item_id.title: FitItemId
fit_item_id.description: Id of a fit item of a protocol, as in catalog/protocol-catalog.json.
